user.title: Set up Parqet Companion
user.description: Add another Parqet account or create a Combined entry for existing accounts.

combined.title: Create Parqet Combined
combined.description: Select at least two accounts with the same portfolio currency. The Combined entry owns the aggregate sensors and fails closed if a selected source is unavailable.

pick_implementation.title: Pick authentication method
pick_implementation.description: Pick an authentication method to connect to your Parqet account.

pick_portfolio.title: Select Portfolios
pick_portfolio.description: Choose which portfolios to track. Each portfolio shows up as its own device under this Parqet account.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Parqet
reauth_confirm.description: Your Parqet session has expired. Please re-authenticate to continue receiving portfolio data.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Parqet API.
error.at_least_two_sources: Select at least two Parqet accounts.
error.mixed_currency: All selected portfolios must use the same currency.

abort.already_configured: This Parqet account is already configured.
abort.combined_not_available: Parqet Combined requires at least two account entries and can only be configured once.
abort.combined_reconfigure_via_options: Use Configure on the Parqet Combined entry to change its selected source accounts.
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Parqet API.
abort.no_portfolios: No portfolios found in your Parqet account. Create at least one portfolio at app.parqet.com, then try again.
abort.reauth_required: Your stored Parqet token is no longer valid. Use the reauth flow instead.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: Parqet refused the authentication. The authorization code may have been used already — try adding the integration again with a single browser tab.
abort.oauth_failed: Parqet refused the authentication. Try adding the integration again.

data.snapshot_weekdays_only: Weekdays only (Mo-Fr) — skips weekends, Monday uses Friday's snapshot

combined.title: Parqet Combined sources
combined.description: Select the account entries owned by this Combined entry. All selected portfolios must use the same currency.

error.at_least_two_sources: Select at least two Parqet accounts.
error.mixed_currency: All selected portfolios must use the same currency.

portfolio_deleted.title: Portfolio "{portfolio_name}" removed from Parqet
portfolio_deleted.description: The portfolio "{portfolio_name}" tracked by "{entry_title}" is no longer on your Parqet account. It has been removed from this integration so refreshes stop failing. If this was unintended, restore the portfolio on Parqet, then reconfigure the integration to track it again.

dump_diagnostics.name: Dump diagnostics
dump_diagnostics.description: Write a Parqet diagnostics snapshot (frontend registration, Lovelace resources, coordinator state) to a persistent notification. Useful for debugging card loading issues.
